## Company Profile
Angu Wire Mesh is a China-based manufacturer and exporter specializing in industrial wire mesh,
gabion systems, slope protection nets, and perimeter security fencing. Located in Anping County,
Hebei — the "Wire Mesh Capital of China" — we serve B2B buyers, engineering contractors, and
industrial distributors worldwide.

## Core Products
- Gabion Boxes (hot-dipped galvanized, PVC coated, reinforced) — 2×1×1m standard
- Reno Mattresses — 6×2×0.3m riverbed/channel lining
- Slope Protection Nets — active (DNS-50, 50kJ) and passive (GL-100, 100kJ) rockfall barriers
- Welded Wire Mesh — 50mm × 2.0mm galvanized construction mesh
- Chain Link Fence — 50mm × 2.5mm heavy-duty diamond fence
- Hexagonal Wire Mesh — 25mm double-twist for gabion & poultry enclosures
- Razor Barbed Wire — BTO-22 concertina coils for high-security perimeters
- Highway Guardrail — W-beam AASHTO M180 / EN 1317 compliant
- Stainless Steel Rope Net — 304/316 hand-woven for zoo & architectural safety
- Noise Barriers — highway/equipment/factory soundproof panels 15-35dB reduction
- Hesco Bastion Blast Wall — 1×1×1m military-grade welded mesh with geotextile
- Crowd Control Barriers — galvanized & aluminum event fencing

## Core Strengths
- ISO 9001:2015 certified factory; CE certification for rockfall protection products
- ETAG 027 tested slope protection systems; ASTM A975/A975M compliant gabion boxes
- Full OEM/ODM capability: custom wire diameters (1.5-5.0mm), mesh apertures, dimensions, surface treatments
- In-house quality lab: tensile testing, zinc coating weight analysis, salt spray chambers
- Export experience: 15+ years serving 60+ countries
- Production capacity: 5,000+ tons/month across welded mesh, gabion, and fencing lines
- Logistics: FOB Tianjin/Xingang port; CIF/CFR worldwide; full container or LCL

## Application Scenarios
- Civil Engineering: retaining walls, erosion control, riverbank protection, channel lining
- Transportation Infrastructure: highway slope stabilization, railway rockfall barriers, bridge scour protection
- Mining & Quarrying: tailings dam reinforcement, haul road protection, screening mesh
- Military & Security: perimeter fortification, Hesco bastion deployment, razor wire barriers
- Construction: concrete reinforcement, site isolation fencing, temporary enclosures
- Events & Crowd Management: concert barriers, sports field fencing, queue systems
- Landscaping & Architecture: decorative gabion walls, green wall support, zoo enclosures
- Industrial: machine guards, filtration screens, noise control barriers
